title: 24 Sales Conversations for an Industrial Packaging Manufacturer
challenge: A packaging manufacturer relied heavily on repeat customers, channel partners and exhibitions for new orders. Its leadership wanted to build a predictable outbound pipeline.
solution: Myntmore identified procurement and operations stakeholders across target industries. We created outreach centred on packaging requirements, manufacturing capacity and supply reliability, supported by founder-led content.
results: Improved visibility among target procurement teams.
